'''Hobbs DaVoren''' is the innkeeper of the [[Three Crowns Inn]], the local inn of [[Aturo's Orchard]].

== History ==
In {{ne|998}}, the town of Aturo's Orchard is attacked by the [[Children of the Light]]. Hobbs's brother's farm is attacked by the Children of the Light, leaving his niece [[Issa DaVoren|Issa]] alone and scared until she is brought to her uncle.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
